text: Great app, the app tracks for 19 days in the past, I hope it tracks for infinity but that's just a wish, as a student in egypt who can't afford the crazy prices of other habit tracking apps this app is perfect for me, if I want to cover the 19 days tracking limit I would just have to screenshot the stats every 19 days! perfect app, thanks
